title: DESIGN.md IS TRANSLATED, NOT PARSED
lead: Google Labs' alpha DESIGN.md format: ordered design rationale plus optional YAML tokens. An agent translates it into settings, artwork prompts and a data-only fixture. The engine never reads the Markdown; it pins the source hash and checks that every requirement quotes it.

flow.title: node tools/render.mjs <fixture>
flow.text: the standard fit, font and export checks

stories.label: THE LINE-HEIGHT STORY
stories.text: A 1.1 headline line height put the glyphs above their box. The Chromium render refused the clipped text. The fix was in the data-only recipe (the fixture's display line height), 1.1 to 1.3. No fit guard was loosened.

stories.label: BLOCKED, NOT SIMPLIFIED
stories.text: A brief the engine cannot support (a second font family, gradients, arbitrary CSS) comes back as a blocked intake with the unsupported fields named, never as a silently simplified render.

example: Worked example: examples/2026-10-12-design-intake/ (DESIGN.md, fixture.json, both backend renders)
